newsitem.title: MALTA: Maltese Labour Party claims victory.
newsitem.headline: Maltese Labour Party claims victory.

text.p: Maltese Labour Party leader Alfred Sant claimed victory over the ruling Nationalists on Sunday in the island's general election in which he committed the party to scrap Malta's bid for European Union membership.
Speaking on radio, he said: "There are clear indications that there is a Labour victory and I want to reaffirm our intention to form a government for all the people of Malta and Gozo."
